justification: The limited overlap is that both include human/anthropomorphic imagery and circular motifs: A has naturalistic profile human figures and rosette-like circles in borders, while B has a single frontal schematic body with circular eyes or body marks. The biggest difference is that A is a narrative procession with multiple people, animals in profile, a tree, staffs, and patterned borders, whereas B is a solitary abstract anthropomorphic figure covered with geometric/body-part markings.
